raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Four modules import FlashInfer at module level behind `is_cuda()` alone: `layers/sampler.py`, `speculative/dflash_utils.py`, `layers/quantization/fp8_utils.py` and `layers/attention/vision.py`. Importing `sglang.srt.entrypoints.http_server` reaches all four, so a CUDA environment without FlashInfer fails at import time before any backend is chosen:

```
File ".../sglang/srt/layers/quantization/fp8_utils.py", line 255, in <module>
    from flashinfer import bmm_fp8 as _raw_bmm_fp8_batched
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'flashinfer'
```

Every other FlashInfer-dependent path is already selected at runtime (attention backend, sampling backend, the per-tensor fp8 helper guarded by `is_flashinfer_available()`); these four were the remaining hard import-time dependencies.

## Modifications

- Replace the four eager imports with `LazyImport` from `sglang.utils`, which resolves the attribute on first call. With FlashInfer installed the bound names resolve to the same objects (checked with `is` for all six names), so behaviour is unchanged. Without it the server imports and starts, the sampling backend defaults to `pytorch` as it already does when FlashInfer is absent, and a path that really needs FlashInfer still raises `ModuleNotFoundError` at the call instead of at import.
- Add `test/registered/unit/test_import_without_flashinfer.py` (base-b, 1-gpu-small): imports the HTTP entrypoint in a subprocess with `flashinfer` blocked in `sys.modules`. It fails on current main at the `fp8_utils` import and passes with this change.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: no numerics change. The lazily bound names are the same FlashInfer functions once resolved.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: `LazyImport.__call__` adds one attribute lookup per call after the first resolution; the four names are called from already Python-dispatched paths.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). `pre-commit run --files <changed files>` passes, including `check-no-bare-pytest-main` and `check-registered-tests`.
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). `pytest test/registered/unit/test_import_without_flashinfer.py`: 1 passed on a CUDA machine; the same subprocess import fails on main.
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). No user-facing flag.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). Not applicable, see above.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+"""Server start must not need FlashInfer.
+
+Importing the HTTP entrypoint reaches every module that bound FlashInfer at
+module level behind ``is_cuda()`` alone (sampler, dflash_utils, fp8_utils,
+attention/vision); a FlashInfer-less CUDA image failed there at import time.
+"""
+
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=25, stage="base-b", runner_config="1-gpu-small")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="is_cuda() gates the imports under test"
+)
+def test_http_server_imports_without_flashinfer() -> None:
+    # None in sys.modules makes `import flashinfer` raise and find_spec return None.
+    code = (
+        "import sys; sys.modules['flashinfer'] = None; "
+        "import sglang.srt.entrypoints.http_server"
+    )
+    proc = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, "-c", code], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600
+    )
+    assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr[-3000:]
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__]))
